name: Test Coverage Gate
description: Enforces §4.3.1 Tests Before Done. Fires on Stop/SubagentStop. Compares changed source files on the current branch against changed test files. If code files changed but no corresponding test files changed, emits a TEST-COVERAGE-VIOLATION sentinel. Non-blocking — uses the sentinel pattern so a Tech Lead gate or the principal can decide on recovery.
side_effects: emits TEST-COVERAGE-VIOLATION sentinel lines to stdout and stderr
platform_notes: Requires git. Uses git diff against origin/main (or the configured base branch). Falls back to HEAD~1 when no upstream is present. Cross-platform via 'ai hooks run'.
